Toy Story 5: "Shed Toys" BTS | Pixar's Set the Scene

Directors Andrew Stanton, Kenna Harris, and Producer Lindsey Collins give an exclusive behind the scenes look at storyboards, clips, concept art, and more from TOY STORY 5, now streaming on Disney+!
